---
title: "Univariate Linear Model"
---

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)

###############################################################################
#Slave - Univariate Linear Regression Script in JS
###############################################################################

lin_reg <- 
'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION js_linear_regression_slave(
  tbl text, xcol text, ycol text
)
RETURNS TABLE(sum_x float8, sum_y float8, sum_xy float8, sum_x2 float8)

SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
  if (tbl !== "mytable") {
    throw new Error("Query denied, you may have not the permission to execute this command. Try again with an authorized Query from the query list");
  }
  
  var sql = "SELECT " + xcol + " AS x, " + ycol + " AS y FROM " + tbl +
            " WHERE " + xcol + " IS NOT NULL AND " + ycol + " IS NOT NULL";
  var rows = plv8.execute(sql);

  var n = rows.length;
  if (n === 0) {
    plv8.return_next({ sum_x: sum_x, sum_y: sum_y, sum_xy: sum_xy, sum_x2: sum_x2 });
  }

  var sum_x = 0, sum_y = 0, sum_xy = 0, sum_x2 = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    var x = parseFloat(rows[i].x);
    var y = parseFloat(rows[i].y);
    sum_x += x;
    sum_y += y;
    sum_xy += x * y;
    sum_x2 += x * x;
  }

  plv8.return_next({ sum_x: sum_x, sum_y: sum_y, sum_xy: sum_xy, sum_x2: sum_x2 });
$$ LANGUAGE plv8;'

```
